A standard-library independent algebra checker passed 25,594 rational/precision test cases; finite checks are not used to justify the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The source advertises pathwise A-stability for stiff equations, which does not entail positive computed concentrations/populations. This result quantifies the complete sign-risk law, rare first negative-step waiting scale, and the sharp possibility of reducing sign risk while retaining the formal third-order expectations. A natural one-moment optimization exhibits a nontrivial 2.24582949… frontier beyond the uniform safe radius of 2, and a singular endpoint at 1+sqrt(3). It is scientifically specific to scalar decay and does not claim preserved global low-regularity order after redesigning sampling.
